direction.educational_goal: Conocer a Lumi y la granja.
direction.reason_es: Presentar a Lumi y la granja con una acción contenida, conservando exactamente la composición aprobada.

camera.reason_es: Conservar la perspectiva y la anatomía visibles en la imagen aprobada; no revelar geometría oculta.

animal_continuity: Preserve one cow at source-left, one sheep behind Lumi at source-right, and one hen at lower source-right. Preserve their approved colors, silhouettes, positions and visibility. No added animal, count change, new action, or background substitution.

verified_blockers.detail: Checkpoint stores the initial SOURCE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED descriptor. The runtime binds media/topology only; required shot contract, visual facts/reviews, source QA, locks and editorial evidence are not projected into the compiler envelope.
The director compares every object color with a fixed flower_red/yellow/blue map. Cow/sheep/hen have no entry; a schema-valid nonempty animal color cannot satisfy that comparison.
The shared projection currently names the garden. A farm direction must preserve its approved world, not silently change it.

minimum_next_change: Materialize this static direction through the existing runtime using verified original bytes, exact source-QA receipt, original human decision and immutable prepared binding. No provider authority.
world_description: sunlit farm, red barn and fence; cow at source-left, sheep behind Lumi at source-right, hen at lower source-right; retain the exact approved crop and lighting
